name: Paradigm of Vainglory
description: Your swings fire as [effect:wave][dark-gray]piercing waves[/dark-gray][/effect], and you can [effect:hover][dark-gray]hover[/dark-gray][/effect] at full health, [dark-red]but[/dark-red] you strike yourself, bypassing armor, when your waves miss.

effects.explanation: Weapons with lower attack speed fire wider waves and ones with higher range fire waves which travel faster.
Swing directly up to toggle the hover. It disables once you witness your health fall below full.
